biography.plain_text: Hakan Uzan is a Turkish businessman who worked with his brother Cem in Telsim, the mobile operator within their family's business group. Their father Kemal established the construction enterprise from which the group developed. Uzan later acquired the luxury phone business Vertu through Baferton, extending his commercial interests beyond the family's former Turkish operations.

long_biography.plain_text:
Turkish businessman Hakan Uzan became president of Adanaspor when the football club entered the Uzan group's ownership. The club was reorganised as a company after financial difficulties, and promotion to the top division became its immediate sporting objective. An unsuccessful play-off campaign was followed by a strengthened squad and promotion the following season.

When he acquired Vertu in 2017, Uzan said through a spokesman that he wanted to invest in its recognised luxury niche and work with the existing team. Its British manufacturing operation closed later that year. At the time, he retained brand, technology and design rights.
